_comment: The jurisdiction of Russian-language documents (core/jurisdiction.py): [value, pattern] pairs, the first match wins, this pack before the English one. jurisdiction_designations match the start of the designation (else of the title): the national designations of Kazakhstan (СН РК, СП РК, СТ РК, НП к СП РК EN …) before the Russian ones that share their letters (СП, СНиП), the acts of the Customs Union and the Eurasian Economic Union (ТР ТС, ТР ЕАЭС), the interstate standards (ГОСТ without Р, МСН, МСП: CIS), the Russian ones (ГОСТ Р, СП, СНиП, РД, ПБ, СТО, federal laws), ISO and IEC in Russian letters (INT). jurisdiction_words: the names of a state or a union in the title, the publisher or the source name of a normative document, and (when they say nothing) in the start of its text (the legal form that starts the name of the publisher: ПАО, ООО … a Russian organization, ТОО one of Kazakhstan); a document they give two values is left unsure.
